related.title: BGP-4：屬性政策與路由候選篩選
related.titleEn: BGP-4: attribute policy and candidate filtering
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受最終映射與序號規則一致；4/2 s只是本地批次服務時間下界，不是全網收斂保證。 交接時須能核對：交付 mac-mobility.csv、重排不變性測試與未解的同序號衝突。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require sequence-consistent mappings;4/2 s are local batch-service lower bounds, not global-convergence guarantees. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver mac-mobility.csv, reordering-invariance tests and unresolved equal-sequence conflicts.
related.difference: 建立prefix、NEXT_HOP、LOCAL_PREF、AS_PATH與拒絕原因欄，先篩選再在合格路由內選擇。
related.differenceEn: Record prefix, NEXT_HOP, LOCAL_PREF, AS_PATH and rejection reason; filter before selecting among eligible routes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
EVPN的MAC移動序號協助選擇更新位置；接收時間較晚不保證通告較新。
教學基準：120/30 = 4 s；對照：120/60 = 2 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

BGP選路先受本地政策與可達性約束；AS_PATH較短不必然勝出。
教學基準：(200-160)/200*100 = 20 %；對照：(200-190)/200*100 = 5 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
EVPN MAC-mobility sequence numbers help select updated locations; later arrival does not guarantee newer information.
Teaching baseline: 120/30 = 4 s; comparison: 120/60 = 2 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

BGP selection is constrained by local policy and reachability; a shorter AS_PATH need not win.
Teaching baseline: (200-160)/200*100 = 20 %; comparison: (200-190)/200*100 = 5 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ECMP：流雜湊偏斜與位元組加權
related.titleEn: ECMP: flow hashing skew and byte weighting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受最終映射與序號規則一致；4/2 s只是本地批次服務時間下界，不是全網收斂保證。 交接時須能核對：交付 mac-mobility.csv、重排不變性測試與未解的同序號衝突。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require sequence-consistent mappings;4/2 s are local batch-service lower bounds, not global-convergence guarantees. related.difference: 以五元組、bucket、bytes建立流表，將同一流的所有封包放在同一桶。
related.differenceEn: Build five-tuple, bucket and byte columns, keeping packets of each flow in one bucket.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

EVPN的MAC移動序號協助選擇更新位置；接收時間較晚不保證通告較新。
教學基準：120/30 = 4 s；對照：120/60 = 2 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

ECMP可按流雜湊分配；流數均勻不代表位元組均勻，重新映射也會影響既有流。
教學基準：40/(100/4) = 1.6 peak/mean；對照：25/(100/4) = 1 peak/mean。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

EVPN MAC-mobility sequence numbers help select updated locations; later arrival does not guarantee newer information.
Teaching baseline: 120/30 = 4 s; comparison: 120/60 = 2 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

ECMP can hash by flow; equal flow counts do not imply equal bytes, and remapping affects established flows.
Teaching baseline: 40/(100/4) = 1.6 peak/mean; comparison: 25/(100/4) = 1 peak/mean. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
